Toons don't play nice on this stage 🎬⚡ Cartoon Chaos is crashing into Azucar with our next gen queens serving full animated mayhem — think clown paint, caped crusaders, and lip syncs sharp enough to cut through Sunday morning static. This is drag turned up to cartoon volume: exaggerated, colorful, and absolutely unhinged in the best way. Free entry, all ages, zero excuses not to pull up. Bring the kids, bring the group chat, bring your favorite childhood character energy because somebody out there is about to become them live on la pista. Mark it now — this is the kind of show people talk about for weeks after 📣🎨

🗓️ Sunday, November 22 • Doors 3PM / Show 3:30PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free entry
🎉 All ages

Primary colors, painted faces, and bass that hits like a Sunday morning cartoon intro 🌈📺 Picture Azucar lit up in comic-book blues and reds, smoke curling under the stage lights, and queens stepping out looking like they walked straight off a cereal box into full fantasy. The crowd's laughing one second, gasping the next — that's the chaos part. Heels clack against la pista like a drumroll before every reveal, and the whole room feels like flipping through channels of pure spectacle. It's silly, it's sharp, it's sensory overload in the sweetest way. Come feel the glow before the lights even hit the stage ✨🎨

Come as your favorite character, come as yourself, come however you want — Cartoon Chaos is built for everybody 🫶🎨 This is an all-ages, free night at Azucar made for the Latinx community and anyone who wants in on the joy. Kids, parents, first-timers, regulars who already know the vibe — doesn't matter, there's a seat for you. Our next gen queens are bringing full cartoon energy to the stage, and the room fills up with that same easy warmth every time: strangers cheering together, families laughing, everyone a little starstruck by the color and the confidence up there. No pretending required, just show up and let the afternoon turn into something memorable 💕
